<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR" data-theme="light">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>3D Print — Precificação</title>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2/dist/umd/supabase.js"></script>
<style>
:root {
--bg:#f4f6f8;--surface:#fff;--surface2:#f8fafc;--border:#e2e8f0;--border2:#cbd5e1;
--t1:#0f172a;--t2:#475569;--t3:#94a3b8;
--blue:#2563eb;--blue-h:#1d4ed8;--blue-s:#eff6ff;--blue-b:#bfdbfe;
--green:#16a34a;--green-s:#f0fdf4;--green-b:#bbf7d0;
--amber:#b45309;--amber-s:#fffbeb;
--red:#dc2626;--red-s:#fef2f2;--red-b:#fecaca;
--sh:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.07),0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.04);
--sh-sm:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.05);
--r:7px;--r2:10px;--sidebar:212px;--hdr:52px;
}
[data-theme="dark"] {
--bg:#0d1117;--surface:#161b22;--surface2:#21262d;--border:#30363d;--border2:#484f58;
--t1:#e6edf3;--t2:#8b949e;--t3:#484f58;
--blue:#58a6ff;--blue-h:#79c0ff;--blue-s:#0d2642;--blue-b:#1f4170;
--green:#3fb950;--green-s:#0a2215;--green-b:#1a4224;
--amber:#d29922;--amber-s:#271c07;
--red:#f85149;--red-s:#2d0e0e;--red-b:#5c1f1f;
--sh:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.4),0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
--sh-sm:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
html{font-size:14px;}
body{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--t1);line-height:1.55;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:5px;height:5px;}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--border2);border-radius:3px;}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent;}
/* HEADER */
.hdr{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:200;height:var(--hdr);background:var(--surface);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 18px;gap:10px;box-shadow:var(--sh-sm);}
.hdr-logo{width:26px;height:26px;background:var(--blue);border-radius:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0;}
.hdr-logo svg{width:14px;height:14px;}
.hdr-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.3px;}
.hdr-divider{width:1px;height:16px;background:var(--border2);margin:0 4px;}
.hdr-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--t3);}
.hdr-right{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
.hdr-saved{font-size:11px;color:var(--t3);}
.icon-btn{width:32px;height:32px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--surface2);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--t2);transition:all .12s;}
.icon-btn:hover{background:var(--border);color:var(--t1);}
.icon-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px;}
/* LAYOUT */
.layout{display:flex;min-height:calc(100vh - var(--hdr));}
/* SIDEBAR */
.sidebar{width:var(--sidebar);background:var(--surface);border-right:1px solid var(--border);padding:8px 6px;flex-shrink:0;position:sticky;top:var(--hdr);height:calc(100vh - var(--hdr));overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;transition:width .22s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
.sidebar.collapsed{width:44px;}
.sidebar.collapsed .nav-group-label{display:none;}
.sidebar.collapsed .nav-item span{display:none;}
.sidebar.collapsed .nav-item{justify-content:center;padding:9px 0;gap:0;}
.sidebar.collapsed .nav-sep{margin:3px 6px;}
.sidebar.collapsed .sb-toggle-lbl{display:none;}
.sidebar.collapsed .sb-toggle-btn{justify-content:center;padding:9px 0;}
.nav-group-label{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--t3);padding:8px 10px 3px;white-space:nowrap;}
.nav-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:var(--r);cursor:pointer;color:var(--t2);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;transition:all .1s;margin-bottom:1px;user-select:none;white-space:nowrap;}
.nav-item:hover{background:var(--surface2);color:var(--t1);}
.nav-item.active{background:var(--blue-s);color:var(--blue);font-weight:600;}
.nav-item svg{width:15px;height:15px;flex-shrink:0;}
.nav-sep{height:1px;background:var(--border);margin:6px 4px;transition:margin .22s;}
.sb-nav-top{flex:1;}
.sb-toggle-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:var(--r);cursor:pointer;color:var(--t3);font-size:12px;font-weight:500;transition:all .1s;user-select:none;white-space:nowrap;border:none;background:none;width:100%;}
.sb-toggle-btn:hover{background:var(--surface2);color:var(--t2);}
.sb-toggle-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px;flex-shrink:0;transition:transform .22s;}
/* MAIN */
.main{flex:1;padding:22px;overflow-y:auto;min-width:0;}
.tab-panel{display:none;}
.tab-panel.active{display:block;}
.page-title{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.3px;margin-bottom:2px;}
.page-sub{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--t2);margin-bottom:18px;}
/* CARD */
.card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:16px;margin-bottom:12px;box-shadow:var(--sh-sm);}
.card-hdr{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:14px;}
.card-title{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;color:var(--t2);}
/* GRID */
.g2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:11px;}
.g3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:11px;}
.span2{grid-column:1/-1;}
/* FORM */
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;}
label{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--t2);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;}
input,select{padding:7px 10px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r);font-size:13px;color:var(--t1);width:100%;outline:none;transition:border-color .12s,box-shadow .12s;}
input:focus,select:focus{border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(37,99,235,.12);}
[data-theme="dark"] input:focus,[data-theme="dark"] select:focus{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(88,166,255,.15);}
input[readonly]{background:var(--surface2);color:var(--t2);cursor:default;}
input[type=checkbox]{width:auto;cursor:pointer;accent-color:var(--blue);}
input[type=number]::-webkit-inner-spin-button,
input[type=number]::-webkit-outer-spin-button{-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;margin:0;}
input[type=number]{-moz-appearance:textfield;appearance:textfield;}
select{cursor:pointer;}
/* BUTTONS */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:7px 13px;border-radius:var(--r);border:none;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:all .12s;line-height:1.4;white-space:nowrap;}
.btn svg{width:13px;height:13px;flex-shrink:0;}
.btn-primary{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--blue-h);}
.btn-success{background:var(--green);color:#fff;}
.btn-success:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);}
.btn-outline{background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--t1);}
.btn-outline:hover{background:var(--surface2);}
.btn-danger{background:var(--red-s);color:var(--red);border:1px solid var(--red-b);}
.btn-danger:hover{filter:brightness(1.05);}
.btn-sm{padding:5px 10px;font-size:12px;}
.btn-xs{padding:3px 7px;font-size:11px;}
.btn-row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
/* DIVIDER */
.div{height:1px;background:var(--border);margin:12px 0;}
/* BADGE */
.badge{display:inline-block;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:999px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.6;}
.badge-blue{background:var(--blue-s);color:var(--blue);border:1px solid var(--blue-b);}
.badge-green{background:var(--green-s);color:var(--green);}
/* COST LINES */
.cost-line{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-size:13px;}
.cost-line:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.cl-label{color:var(--t2);}
.cl-val{font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}
/* RESULT TOTAL */
.result-total{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border-radius:var(--r);padding:13px 15px;margin:10px 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;}
.rt-label{font-size:11px;opacity:.8;margin-bottom:2px;}
.rt-value{font-size:21px;font-weight:800;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:-.5px;}
.rt-sub{font-size:11px;opacity:.6;margin-top:1px;}
/* MP RESULTS */
.mp-result{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r);padding:12px;margin-bottom:8px;background:var(--surface2);}
.mp-result-hdr{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:9px;}
.mp-name{font-weight:700;font-size:13px;}
.mp-fees-info{font-size:11px;color:var(--t3);margin-top:1px;}
.mp-price{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:var(--blue);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-align:right;}
.mp-price-lbl{font-size:10px;color:var(--t3);text-align:right;}
.mp-fee-row{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:7px;}
.mp-chip{background:var(--red-s);color:var(--red);border:1px solid var(--red-b);border-radius:4px;padding:1px 7px;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;}
.mp-profits{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:5px;}
.mp-profit{border-radius:5px;padding:7px 8px;text-align:center;}
.pp-l{font-size:10px;color:var(--t3);margin-bottom:1px;}
.pp-v{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}
.mp-profit.bruto{background:var(--amber-s);}
.mp-profit.bruto .pp-v{color:var(--amber);}
.mp-profit.liquido{background:var(--green-s);}
.mp-profit.liquido .pp-v{color:var(--green);}
.mp-profit.margem{background:var(--blue-s);}
.mp-profit.margem .pp-v{color:var(--blue);}
.mp-profit.lph{background:var(--surface2);}
.mp-profit.lph .pp-v{color:var(--t1);}
/* product name tooltip */
.cat-tip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;max-width:100%;}
.cat-tip-icon{flex-shrink:0;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blue-s);color:var(--blue);font-size:9px;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:help;border:1px solid var(--blue-b);}
#g-tip{display:none;position:fixed;z-index:9000;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;padding:9px 12px;font-size:12px;white-space:pre-line;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.15);min-width:190px;color:var(--t1);font-weight:400;line-height:1.6;pointer-events:none;}
/* catalog filter bar */
.cat-filter-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px;padding:7px 11px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r);box-shadow:var(--sh-sm);}
.cf-grp{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;}
.cf-lbl{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--t3);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;white-space:nowrap;}
.cf-sep{width:1px;height:14px;background:var(--border2);margin:0 2px;flex-shrink:0;}
.cf-sel{height:26px;font-size:12px;padding:0 6px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;background:var(--surface2);color:var(--t1);cursor:pointer;outline:none;transition:border-color .12s;}
.cf-sel:hover,.cf-sel:focus{border-color:var(--blue);}
.cf-num{height:26px;font-size:12px;padding:0 7px;width:58px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;background:var(--surface2);color:var(--t1);outline:none;transition:border-color .12s;}
.cf-num:hover,.cf-num:focus{border-color:var(--blue);}
.cf-chip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;height:26px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:13px;background:var(--surface2);color:var(--t2);font-size:12px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:all .12s;white-space:nowrap;user-select:none;}
.cf-chip:hover{border-color:var(--border2);color:var(--t1);}
.cf-chip.active{background:var(--red-s);border-color:var(--red-b);color:var(--red);}
.cf-chip input{display:none;}
/* TABLE */
.tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;}
.tbl th{text-align:left;padding:8px 11px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--t2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface2);white-space:nowrap;}
.tbl td{padding:6px 11px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);vertical-align:middle;font-size:13px;}
.tbl tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none;}
.tbl tbody tr:hover td{background:var(--surface2);}
.tbl input,.tbl select{padding:4px 7px;font-size:12.5px;}
/* MAT ROWS (calculadora) */
.mat-row{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:5px;}
.mat-row select{flex:2;width:auto;min-width:0;font-size:13px;padding:5px 7px;}
.mat-row input{width:68px;text-align:center;font-size:13px;padding:5px 7px;}
.mat-row-rm{width:22px;height:22px;border:none;border-radius:4px;background:var(--red-s);color:var(--red);cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;line-height:1;}
.mat-row-rm:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);}
/* EMB ROWS (calculadora) */
.emb-row{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:flex-start;padding-bottom:8px;margin-bottom:8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.emb-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;margin-bottom:0;padding-bottom:0;}
.emb-row-item{flex:2;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;}
.emb-row-item select,.emb-row-item input{width:100%;font-size:13px;padding:5px 7px;}
.emb-row-nums{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;}
.emb-row-nums input{width:58px;padding:5px 7px;font-size:13px;text-align:center;}
.emb-cat-badge{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--blue);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap;padding:5px 2px;}
.emb-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--t2);font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap;width:80px;text-align:right;padding:5px 2px;}
/* EMB CATALOG TABLE */
.emb-cat-hdr,.emb-cat-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:18px 1.6fr 55px 85px 72px 65px 88px 145px 58px 28px;gap:6px;align-items:center;}
.emb-cat-dim{display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:center;}
.emb-cat-dim input{width:36px!important;text-align:center;padding:5px 3px!important;}
.emb-cat-dim span{color:var(--t3);font-size:11px;}
.emb-cat-hdr{font-size:10.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--t3);font-weight:600;padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);margin-bottom:8px;}
.emb-cat-row{margin-bottom:4px;border-radius:6px;transition:background .1s;}
.emb-cat-row.drag-over{background:var(--bg2);outline:1.5px dashed var(--blue);}
.emb-cat-row input,.emb-cat-row select{padding:5px 7px;font-size:13px;}
.emb-cat-auto{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--blue);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;padding:4px 2px;}
.drag-handle{cursor:grab;color:var(--t3);font-size:16px;line-height:1;padding:2px;user-select:none;display:flex;align-items:center;}
.drag-handle:active{cursor:grabbing;}
/* KIT EDITOR */
.emb-kit-editor{display:none;background:var(--bg2);border-left:3px solid var(--blue);border-radius:0 6px 6px 6px;margin-bottom:8px;margin-left:24px;}
.emb-kit-editor.open{display:block;}
.emb-kit-inner{padding:10px 14px;}
.emb-kit-title{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--t2);margin-bottom:10px;}
.kit-item-row{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px;}
.kit-item-row span.kit-nome{flex:1;font-size:13px;}
.kit-item-row input{width:65px;text-align:center;}
.kit-item-row .kit-unit{font-size:12px;color:var(--t2);width:22px;}
/* COST ROWS */
.cost-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 120px 28px;gap:7px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px;}
.cost-row input{padding:6px 8px;font-size:13px;}
/* SOLAR ROW */
.solar-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 13px;background:var(--green-s);border:1px solid var(--green-b);border-radius:var(--r);margin-top:8px;}
.solar-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--green);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;flex:1;}
.solar-row input{width:110px;border-color:var(--green-b);}
/* INFO BOX */
.info-box{background:var(--blue-s);border:1px solid var(--blue-b);border-radius:var(--r);padding:11px 13px;font-size:13px;color:var(--blue);}
.info-box.green{background:var(--green-s);border-color:var(--green-b);color:var(--green);}
/* PRODUCT INDICATOR */
.product-indicator{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 13px;border-radius:var(--r);margin-bottom:12px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface);}
.pi-code{font-family:'SF Mono','Fira Code',monospace;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:4px;white-space:nowrap;}
.pi-code.new-code{background:var(--blue-s);color:var(--blue);border:1px solid var(--blue-b);}
.pi-code.saved-code{background:var(--green-s);color:var(--green);border:1px solid var(--green-b);}
.pi-name{font-size:13px;color:var(--t2);flex:1;}
.pi-clear{cursor:pointer;color:var(--t3);font-size:15px;line-height:1;padding:2px 5px;border-radius:4px;transition:all .1s;}
.pi-clear:hover{background:var(--red-s);color:var(--red);}
/* SEARCH */
.search-wrap{position:relative;margin-bottom:11px;}
.si-wrap{position:relative;}
.si-wrap svg{position:absolute;left:9px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--t3);pointer-events:none;}
.si-wrap input{padding-left:30px;}
.search-dd{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 2px);left:0;right:0;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r);z-index:100;max-height:230px;overflow-y:auto;box-shadow:var(--sh);display:none;}
.sd-item{padding:9px 13px;cursor:pointer;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-size:13px;}
.sd-item:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.sd-item:hover{background:var(--blue-s);}
.si-code{font-family:monospace;font-weight:700;color:var(--blue);margin-right:7px;font-size:11.5px;}
.si-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--t3);margin-top:1px;}
/* CALC LAYOUT */
.calc-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 355px;gap:12px;align-items:start;}
.results-panel{position:sticky;top:calc(var(--hdr) + 22px);}
/* CATALOG STATS */
.cat-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px;}
.stat-box{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r);padding:11px 13px;box-shadow:var(--sh-sm);}
.stat-val{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:var(--blue);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:-.5px;}
.stat-lbl{font-size:11px;color:var(--t3);margin-top:1px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;}
/* SUMMARY BOX */
.sum-box{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden;}
.sum-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:9px 13px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-size:13px;}
.sum-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.sr-label{color:var(--t2);}
.sr-val{font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}
.sum-total{background:var(--surface2);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:11px 13px;border-top:2px solid var(--border2);font-weight:700;font-size:14.5px;}
/* IMAGE UPLOAD */
.img-upload-area{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px;background:var(--surface2);border:1px dashed var(--border2);border-radius:var(--r);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .12s;}
.img-upload-area:hover{border-color:var(--blue);}
.img-upload-area input[type=file]{display:none;}
.img-upload-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--t2);font-size:12.5px;flex:1;}
.img-upload-label svg{width:16px;height:16px;flex-shrink:0;}
.img-thumb{width:46px;height:46px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:5px;border:1px solid var(--border);display:none;flex-shrink:0;}
.img-remove{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;color:var(--t3);padding:2px 5px;border-radius:4px;font-size:13px;transition:all .1s;display:none;}
.img-remove:hover{background:var(--red-s);color:var(--red);}
/* CATALOG ANALYSIS PANEL */
.cat-mp-tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px;}
.cat-mp-tbl th{text-align:left;padding:5px 10px;font-size:11px;color:var(--t3);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border2);}
.cat-mp-tbl td{padding:7px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}
.cat-mp-tbl tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none;}
.cat-analysis-wrap{padding:14px 20px;background:var(--bg2);border-top:2px solid var(--blue);display:flex;gap:24px;align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.cat-comp-box{min-width:190px;max-width:230px;}
.cat-comp-box label{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--t3);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px;}
.cat-comp-box .comp-input-row{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px;}
.cat-comp-box .comp-input-row span{color:var(--t3);font-size:13px;}
.cat-comp-box .comp-meta{font-size:12px;color:var(--t3);line-height:1.8;}
.cat-comp-box .comp-meta strong{color:var(--t1);}
/* BULK EDIT BAR */
.bulk-bar{display:none;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;background:var(--blue-s);border:1.5px solid var(--blue-b);border-radius:var(--r);padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:10px;}
.bulk-bar.visible{display:flex;}
.bulk-count{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--blue);white-space:nowrap;}
.bulk-sep{width:1px;height:20px;background:var(--blue-b);flex-shrink:0;}
/* IMAGE TOOLTIP IN CATALOG */
.img-trigger{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:5px;background:var(--blue-s);color:var(--blue);cursor:pointer;border:1px solid var(--blue-b);}
.img-trigger svg{width:14px;height:14px;}
.img-popup{display:none;position:fixed;z-index:600;pointer-events:none;}
.img-popup img{width:180px;height:160px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18);display:block;}
.img-trigger:hover + .img-popup,.img-popup:hover{display:block;}
.no-img{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:5px;color:var(--t3);}
.no-img svg{width:14px;height:14px;}
/* MODAL */
.modal-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.45);z-index:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;}
.modal-overlay.hidden{display:none;}
.modal{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r2);width:100%;max-width:520px;max-height:80vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.25);}
.modal-hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:16px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.modal-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;}
.modal-close{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;color:var(--t2);font-size:20px;line-height:1;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;}
.modal-close:hover{background:var(--red-s);color:var(--red);}
.modal-body{padding:16px 18px;overflow-y:auto;flex:1;}
.modal-footer{padding:12px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;}
.bk-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r);margin-bottom:7px;background:var(--surface2);}
.bk-item:hover{border-color:var(--blue-b);}
.bk-ts{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--t1);font-weight:500;flex:1;}
.bk-age{font-size:11px;color:var(--t3);}
/* TOAST */
.toast{position:fixed;bottom:20px;right:20px;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:var(--r);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s;pointer-events:none;z-index:1000;box-shadow:var(--sh);}
.toast.show{opacity:1;}
@keyframes spin{from{transform:rotate(0deg)}to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
/* RESPONSIVE */
@media(max-width:980px){.calc-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;}.results-panel{position:static;}}
@media(max-width:720px){.sidebar{width:48px;}.nav-item span{display:none;}.nav-group-label{display:none;}.g3{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}.cat-stats{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}
@media(max-width:520px){.main{padding:12px;}.g2,.g3{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="g-tip"></div>
<!-- HEADER -->
<header class="hdr">
<div class="hdr-logo">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="6 9 6 2 18 2 18 9"/><path d="M6 18H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h16a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-2"/><rect x="6" y="14" width="12" height="8"/></svg>
</div>
<span class="hdr-name">3D Print</span>
<div class="hdr-divider"></div>
<span class="hdr-sub">Precificação</span>
<div class="hdr-right">
<span id="presence-indicator" style="display:none;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:11px;color:var(--green);background:var(--green-s);border:1px solid var(--green-b);padding:2px 9px;border-radius:999px;">
<span style="width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--green);border-radius:50%;display:inline-block;"></span>
<span></span>
</span>
<span id="hdr-user" style="font-size:12px;color:var(--t2);font-weight:600;display:none;align-items:center;gap:5px;">
<svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M20 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H8a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4"/></svg>
<span id="hdr-user-name"></span>
</span>
<button class="icon-btn" onclick="forceSync()" id="sync-btn" title="Forçar sincronização com nuvem" style="display:none;">
<svg id="sync-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="23 4 23 10 17 10"/><polyline points="1 20 1 14 7 14"/><path d="M3.51 9a9 9 0 0 1 14.85-3.36L23 10M1 14l4.64 4.36A9 9 0 0 0 20.49 15"/></svg>
</button>
<span class="hdr-saved" id="last-saved">Não salvo</span>
<button class="icon-btn" onclick="signOut()" id="logout-btn" title="Sair" style="display:none;">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4"/><polyline points="16 17 21 12 16 7"/><line x1="21" y1="12" x2="9" y2="12"/></svg>
</button>
<button class="icon-btn" onclick="exportData()" title="Exportar backup JSON">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/><polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"/><line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"/></svg>
</button>
<button class="icon-btn" onclick="importData()" title="Importar backup JSON">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/><polyline points="17 8 12 3 7 8"/><line x1="12" y1="3" x2="12" y2="15"/></svg>
</button>
<button class="icon-btn" onclick="showBackups()" title="Histórico de backups automáticos">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><polyline points="12 6 12 12 16 14"/></svg>
</button>
<button class="icon-btn" onclick="toggleTheme()" title="Alternar tema" id="theme-btn">
<svg id="theme-icon-moon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z"/></svg>
<svg id="theme-icon-sun" style="display:none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5"/><line x1="12" y1="1" x2="12" y2="3"/><line x1="12" y1="21" x2="12" y2="23"/><line x1="4.22" y1="4.22" x2="5.64" y2="5.64"/><line x1="18.36" y1="18.36" x2="19.78" y2="19.78"/><line x1="1" y1="12" x2="3" y2="12"/><line x1="21" y1="12" x2="23" y2="12"/><line x1="4.22" y1="19.78" x2="5.64" y2="18.36"/><line x1="18.36" y1="5.64" x2="19.78" y2="4.22"/></svg>
</button>
</div>
</header>
<div class="layout">
<!-- SIDEBAR -->
<nav class="sidebar">
<div class="sb-nav-top">
<div style="border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);margin-bottom:4px;padding-bottom:4px;">
<button class="sb-toggle-btn" id="sb-toggle-btn" onclick="toggleSidebar()" title="Recolher">
<svg id="sb-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="15 18 9 12 15 6"/></svg>
<span class="sb-toggle-lbl">Recolher</span>
</button>
</div>
<div class="nav-group-label">Principal</div>
<div class="nav-item active" data-tab="calcular" onclick="showTab('calcular',this)" title="Calcular">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="4" y="2" width="16" height="20" rx="2"/><line x1="8" y1="7" x2="16" y2="7"/><circle cx="8" cy="11" r=".5" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="12" cy="11" r=".5" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="16" cy="11" r=".5" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="8" cy="15" r=".5" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="12" cy="15" r=".5" fill="currentColor"/><line x1="16" y1="15" x2="16" y2="19"/><line x1="14" y1="17" x2="18" y2="17"/></svg>
<span>Calcular</span>
</div>
<div class="nav-item" data-tab="catalogo" onclick="showTab('catalogo',this)" title="Catálogo">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M2 3h6a4 4 0 0 1 4 4v14a3 3 0 0 0-3-3H2z"/><path d="M22 3h-6a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v14a3 3 0 0 1 3-3h7z"/></svg>
<span>Catálogo</span>
</div>
<div class="nav-sep"></div>
<div class="nav-group-label">Configurar</div>
<div class="nav-item" data-tab="custos" onclick="showTab('custos',this)" title="Custos Fixos">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="12" y1="1" x2="12" y2="23"/><path d="M17 5H9.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 0 7h5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 7H6"/></svg>
<span>Custos Fixos</span>
</div>
<div class="nav-item" data-tab="materiais" onclick="showTab('materiais',this)" title="Materiais">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="12 2 2 7 12 12 22 7 12 2"/><polyline points="2 17 12 22 22 17"/><polyline points="2 12 12 17 22 12"/></svg>
<span>Materiais</span>
</div>
<div class="nav-item" data-tab="impressoras" onclick="showTab('impressoras',this)" title="Impressoras">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="6 9 6 2 18 2 18 9"/><path d="M6 18H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h16a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-2"/><rect x="6" y="14" width="12" height="8"/></svg>
<span>Impressoras</span>
</div>
<div class="nav-item" data-tab="embalagens" onclick="showTab('embalagens',this)" title="Embalagens">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 16V8a2 2 0 0 0-1-1.73l-7-4a2 2 0 0 0-2 0l-7 4A2 2 0 0 0 3 8v8a2 2 0 0 0 1 1.73l7 4a2 2 0 0 0 2 0l7-4A2 2 0 0 0 21 16z"/></svg>
<span>Embalagens</span>
</div>
<div class="nav-item" data-tab="marketplaces" onclick="showTab('marketplaces',this)" title="Marketplaces">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M6 2L3 6v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h14a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V6l-3-4z"/><line x1="3" y1="6" x2="21" y2="6"/><path d="M16 10a4 4 0 0 1-8 0"/></svg>
<span>Marketplaces</span>
</div>
</div><!-- sb-nav-top -->
</nav>
<main class="main">
<!-- ===== CALCULAR ===== -->
<div class="tab-panel active" id="tab-calcular">
<div class="page-title">Calcular Precificação</div>
<div class="page-sub">Preencha os dados da peça. Os resultados atualizam em tempo real.</div>
<div class="search-wrap">
<div class="si-wrap">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"/></svg>
<input type="text" id="search-input" placeholder="Buscar peça por código (P001) ou nome para editar..." oninput="onSearchInput()" onfocus="onSearchFocus()" autocomplete="off">
</div>
<div class="search-dd" id="search-dd"></div>
</div>
<div class="product-indicator" id="product-indicator">
<span class="pi-code new-code" id="pi-code">NOVA PEÇA</span>
<span class="pi-name" id="pi-name">Preencha os dados e salve no catálogo</span>
<span class="pi-clear" onclick="clearProduct()" title="Nova peça">✕</span>
</div>
<div class="calc-layout">
<!-- LEFT -->
<div>
<div class="card">
<div class="card-title" style="margin-bottom:13px">Modelo</div>
<div class="g2">
<div class="field span2"><label>Nome da Peça</label><input type="text" id="c_nome" placeholder="Ex: Suporte articulado para celular" oninput="calcular()"></div>
<div class="field span2"><label>Arquivo STL</label><input type="text" id="c_stl" placeholder="nome_do_arquivo.stl" oninput="calcular()"></div>
<div class="field span2">
<label>Foto da Peça</label>
<div class="img-upload-area" onclick="document.getElementById('img-upload').click()">
<input type="file" id="img-upload" accept="image/*" onchange="handleImageUpload(this)">
<label class="img-upload-label" onclick="event.stopPropagation();document.getElementById('img-upload').click()">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="1.5"/><polyline points="21 15 16 10 5 21"/></svg>
<span id="img-upload-label-text">Clique para adicionar uma foto da peça</span>
</label>
<img id="img-thumb" class="img-thumb" src="" alt="">
<button class="img-remove" id="img-remove-btn" onclick="event.stopPropagation();clearImage()" title="Remover foto">✕</button>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field"><label>Impressora</label><select id="c_impressora" onchange="calcular()"><option value="">Selecionar...</option></select></div>
<div class="field">
<label>Tempo de Impressão</label>
<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;">
<input type="number" id="c_tempo_h" step="1" min="0" value="1" oninput="calcular()" style="width:70px;text-align:center;">
<span style="color:var(--t2);font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap;">h</span>
<input type="number" id="c_tempo_m" step="1" min="0" max="59" value="0" oninput="calcular()" style="width:70px;text-align:center;">
<span style="color:var(--t2);font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap;">min</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field span2">
<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px;">
<label style="margin:0;">Filamento / Cores</label>
<button class="btn btn-outline btn-xs" onclick="addMatRow()">+ Cor</button>
</div>
<div id="mat-rows"></div>
<div style="text-align:right;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--t2);margin-top:4px;">
Total: <strong id="mat-total-peso" style="font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;">0g</strong>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field"><label>Quantidade na Mesa</label><input type="number" id="c_qtd" step="1" min="1" value="1" oninput="calcular()"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="card">
<div class="card-hdr">
<div class="card-title">Embalagens e Acessórios</div>
<button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="addEmbRow()">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg>
Adicionar
</button>
</div>
<div id="emb-rows"></div>
<div style="border-top:1px solid var(--border);margin-top:10px;padding-top:10px;">
<div style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--t3);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px;">Recomendar caixa por dimensões</div>
<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;">
<span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--t2);">Peça (cm):</span>
<input type="number" id="dim_l" placeholder="Comp" step="0.5" min="0" style="width:60px;text-align:center;" oninput="recEmb()">
<span style="color:var(--t3);font-size:13px;">×</span>
<input type="number" id="dim_w" placeholder="Larg" step="0.5" min="0" style="width:60px;text-align:center;" oninput="recEmb()">
<span style="color:var(--t3);font-size:13px;">×</span>
<input type="number" id="dim_h" placeholder="Alt" step="0.5" min="0" style="width:60px;text-align:center;" oninput="recEmb()">
<span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--t3);">+ 1cm/lado</span>
</div>
<div id="emb-rec" style="margin-top:8px;"></div>
</div>
<div style="text-align:right;font-size:12px;color:var(--t2);padding-top:6px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);margin-top:10px;">
Total: <strong id="emb-total" style="font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;">R$ 0,00</strong>
</div>
</div>
<div class="card">
<div class="card-title" style="margin-bottom:13px">Ajustes de Cálculo</div>
<div class="g2">
<div class="field"><label>Taxa de Falhas (%)</label><input type="number" id="c_falhas" step="1" min="0" max="50" value="8" oninput="calcular()"></div>
<div class="field"><label>Unidades previstas / mês</label><input type="number" id="c_unidades_mes" step="1" min="1" value="40" oninput="calcular()"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="card" style="padding:13px;">
<div class="btn-row">
<button class="btn btn-success" onclick="saveProduct()">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M19 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h11l5 5v11a2 2 0 0 1-2 2z"/><polyline points="17 21 17 13 7 13 7 21"/><polyline points="7 3 7 8 15 8"/></svg>
Salvar no Catálogo
</button>
<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="clearProduct()">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6"/><path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6m3 0V4a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h4a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v2"/></svg>
Nova Peça
</button>
</div>
<div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--t3);margin-top:7px;" id="save-hint">Ao salvar, a peça recebe um código permanente (P001, P002…)</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- RIGHT: Results -->
<div class="results-panel">
<div class="card">
<div class="card-title" style="margin-bottom:12px">Composição do Custo</div>
<div class="cost-line"><span class="cl-label">Material</span><span class="cl-val" id="r_mat">R$ 0,00</span></div>
<div class="cost-line"><span class="cl-label">Energia elétrica</span><span class="cl-val" id="r_ener">R$ 0,00</span></div>
<div class="cost-line"><span class="cl-label">Amortização impressora</span><span class="cl-val" id="r_amort">R$ 0,00</span></div>
<div class="cost-line"><span class="cl-label">Embalagem / acessórios</span><span class="cl-val" id="r_emb">R$ 0,00</span></div>
<div class="cost-line"><span class="cl-label">Custo fixo rateado</span><span class="cl-val" id="r_fixo">R$ 0,00</span></div>
<div class="cost-line"><span class="cl-label">Reserva de falhas</span><span class="cl-val" id="r_falha">R$ 0,00</span></div>
<div class="result-total">
<div><div class="rt-label">Custo Unitário</div><div class="rt-sub" id="r_custo_info">—</div></div>
<div class="rt-value" id="r_custo_un">R$ 0,00</div>
</div>
<div id="r-warnings" style="margin-top:8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;"></div>
</div>
<div class="card">
<div class="card-title" style="margin-bottom:12px">Preço por Canal de Venda</div>
<div id="mp-results"><div style="text-align:center;color:var(--t3);padding:18px 0;font-size:13px;">Configure canais na aba Marketplaces</div></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- ===== CATÁLOGO ===== -->
<div class="tab-panel" id="tab-catalogo">
<div class="page-title">Catálogo de Peças</div>
<div class="page-sub">Todas as peças salvas. Clique em Editar para atualizar a precificação.</div>
<div class="cat-stats">
<div class="stat-box"><div class="stat-val" id="cat-total">0</div><div class="stat-lbl">Peças no catálogo</div></div>
<div class="stat-box"><div class="stat-val" id="cat-avg-c">—</div><div class="stat-lbl">Custo médio</div></div>
<div class="stat-box"><div class="stat-val" id="cat-avg-p">—</div><div class="stat-lbl">Com preço praticado</div></div>
</div>
<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px;">
<div class="si-wrap" style="flex:1;">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"/></svg>
<input type="text" id="cat-search" placeholder="Filtrar por código ou nome..." oninput="renderCatalog()">
</div>
<button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="recalcularTudo()" title="Recalcula custo e preço de todas as peças com os custos atuais">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" style="width:14px;height:14px;"><polyline points="23 4 23 10 17 10"/><path d="M20.49 15a9 9 0 1 1-2.12-9.36L23 10"/></svg>
Recalcular Tudo
</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onclick="showTab('calcular',document.querySelector('[data-tab=calcular]'));clearProduct()">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg>
Nova Peça
</button>
</div>
<!-- FILTER BAR -->
<div class="cat-filter-bar" id="cat-filter-bar">
<div class="cf-grp">
<span class="cf-lbl">Ordenar</span>
<select id="cf-sort" class="cf-sel" onchange="renderCatalog()">
<option value="">Padrão</option>
<option value="lph">Lucro/hora</option>
<option value="margem">Margem</option>
<option value="custo">Custo</option>
<option value="tempo">Tempo</option>
<option value="peso">Peso</option>
</select>
<select id="cf-order" class="cf-sel" style="width:44px;padding:0 3px;" onchange="renderCatalog()">
<option value="desc">↓</option>
<option value="asc">↑</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="cf-sep"></div>
<div class="cf-grp">
<span class="cf-lbl">Material</span>
<select id="cf-mat" class="cf-sel" onchange="renderCatalog()"><option value="">Todos</option></select>
</div>
<div class="cf-grp">
<span class="cf-lbl">Impressora</span>
<select id="cf-imp" class="cf-sel" onchange="renderCatalog()"><option value="">Todas</option></select>
</div>
<div class="cf-sep"></div>
<div class="cf-grp">
<span class="cf-lbl">Tempo máx</span>
<input type="number" id="cf-tempo" class="cf-num" step="0.5" min="0" placeholder="h" oninput="renderCatalog()">
</div>
<div class="cf-sep"></div>
<label class="cf-chip" id="cf-abaixo-chip" title="Mostrar apenas peças abaixo da meta de margem em algum canal">
<input type="checkbox" id="cf-abaixo" onchange="this.closest('.cf-chip').classList.toggle('active',this.checked);renderCatalog()">
Abaixo da meta
</label>
<button class="btn btn-outline btn-xs" onclick="resetCatFilters()" style="margin-left:auto;">Limpar</button>
</div>
<!-- BULK EDIT BAR -->
<div class="bulk-bar" id="bulk-bar">
<span class="bulk-count" id="bulk-count">0 selecionados</span>
<span class="bulk-sep"></span>
<select id="bulk-prop" style="font-size:13px;" onchange="updateBulkInput()">
<option value="">— Propriedade —</option>
<option value="falhas">Taxa de Falha (%)</option>
<option value="unidades_mes">Unidades/mês previstas</option>
<option value="materialId">Material</option>
<option value="impressoraId">Impressora</option>
</select>
<input type="number" id="bulk-val-num" step="0.1" min="0" placeholder="Novo valor" style="width:120px;display:none;">
<select id="bulk-val-sel" style="font-size:13px;display:none;"></select>
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onclick="applyBulkEdit()">Aplicar</button>
<button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="clearBulkSelection()">Cancelar</button>
</div>
<div class="card" style="padding:0;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="overflow-x:auto;">
<table class="tbl" id="cat-table">
<thead><tr><th>Código</th><th>Nome</th><th>Material</th><th>Tempo</th><th>Peso</th><th>Custo Un.</th><th style="text-align:center">Ações</th></tr></thead>
<tbody id="cat-body"><tr><td colspan="99" style="text-align:center;color:var(--t3);padding:28px;">Nenhuma peça salva ainda.</td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- ===== CUSTOS FIXOS ===== -->
<div class="tab-panel" id="tab-custos">
<div class="page-title">Custos Fixos Mensais</div>
<div class="page-sub">O que você paga todo mês. São rateados por unidade produzida.</div>
<div class="g2" style="align-items:start;">
<div>
<div class="card">
<div class="card-hdr">
<div class="card-title">Despesas Mensais</div>
<button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="addCostRow()">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg>
Adicionar
</button>
</div>
<div id="cost-rows"></div>
<div class="solar-row">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--green);flex-shrink:0;"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5"/><line x1="12" y1="1" x2="12" y2="3"/><line x1="12" y1="21" x2="12" y2="23"/><line x1="4.22" y1="4.22" x2="5.64" y2="5.64"/><line x1="18.36" y1="18.36" x2="19.78" y2="19.78"/><line x1="1" y1="12" x2="3" y2="12"/><line x1="21" y1="12" x2="23" y2="12"/></svg>
<div class="solar-label">Crédito Painel Solar (desconto na conta)</div>
<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;">
<span style="font-weight:700;color:var(--green);font-size:13px;">- R$</span>
<input type="number" id="cf_solar" step="0.01" min="0" value="0" style="width:100px;border-color:var(--green-b);" oninput="saveCustos()">
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<div class="card">
<div class="card-title" style="margin-bottom:13px">Energia</div>
<div class="g2">
<div class="field"><label>Custo por kWh (R$)</label><input type="number" id="cf_kwh" step="0.01" min="0" value="0.84" oninput="saveCustos()"></div>
<div class="field"><label>Faturamento Previsto (R$/mês)</label><input type="number" id="cf_faturamento" step="100" min="0" value="4000" oninput="saveCustos()"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="card">
<div class="card-title" style="margin-bottom:12px">Resumo</div>
<div class="sum-box">
<div class="sum-row"><span class="sr-label">Total despesas</span><span class="sr-val" id="cf_total_d">R$ 0,00</span></div>
<div class="sum-row"><span class="sr-label" style="color:var(--green)">(-) Crédito solar</span><span class="sr-val" style="color:var(--green)" id="cf_solar_d">- R$ 0,00</span></div>
<div class="sum-total"><span>Custo fixo líquido</span><span id="cf_liq_d">R$ 0,00</span></div>
</div>
<div class="div"></div>
<div class="info-box green">
<div style="font-size:11px;margin-bottom:5px;">Custo fixo por unidade — base: <strong id="cf_unid_ref">40</strong> un./mês</div>
<div style="font-size:22px;font-weight:800;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;" id="cf_por_un">R$ 0,00</div>
<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--t2);margin-top:4px;" id="cf_diss">Dissolução: 0,00% do faturamento</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="card" style="margin-top:12px;">
<div class="card-title" style="margin-bottom:13px;">Padrões para novos produtos</div>
<div class="g2">
<div class="field">
<label>Taxa de Falhas padrão (%)</label>
<input type="number" id="cf_def_falhas" step="1" min="0" max="50" value="8" oninput="saveDefaults()">
</div>
<div class="field">
<label>Unidades previstas / mês padrão</label>
<input type="number" id="cf_def_unidades" step="1" min="1" value="40" oninput="saveDefaults()">
</div>
</div>
<div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--t3);margin-top:8px;">Aplicados automaticamente ao iniciar o cálculo de uma nova peça.</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- ===== MATERIAIS ===== -->
<div class="tab-panel" id="tab-materiais">
<div class="page-title">Materiais</div>
<div class="page-sub">Filamentos, resinas e outros materiais com preço por kg.</div>
<div class="card" style="padding:0;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="padding:13px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">
<div class="card-title" style="margin:0;">Catálogo de Materiais</div>
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onclick="addMaterial()">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg>
Novo Material
</button>
</div>
<div style="overflow-x:auto;">
<table class="tbl"><thead><tr><th>Nome</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Preço / kg (R$)</th><th>Estoque (kg)</th><th>Observações</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody id="mat-body"></tbody></table>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- ===== IMPRESSORAS ===== -->
<div class="tab-panel" id="tab-impressoras">
<div class="page-title">Impressoras</div>
<div class="page-sub">Cadastre as impressoras para calcular consumo de energia e amortização.</div>
<div class="card" style="padding:0;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="padding:13px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">
<div class="card-title" style="margin:0;">Minhas Impressoras</div>
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onclick="addImpressora()">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg>
Nova Impressora
</button>
</div>
<div style="overflow-x:auto;">
<table class="tbl"><thead><tr><th>Nome</th><th>Potência (W)</th><th>Valor de Compra (R$)</th><th>Vida Útil (horas)</th><th>Amort. / hora</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody id="imp-body"></tbody></table>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- ===== EMBALAGENS ===== -->
<div class="tab-panel" id="tab-embalagens">
<div class="page-title">Embalagens e Materiais de Envio</div>
<div class="page-sub">Cadastre cada item com o valor da compra, quantidade e frete. O custo unitário é calculado automaticamente.</div>
<div class="card" style="padding:0;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="padding:13px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">
<div class="card-title" style="margin:0;">Itens Cadastrados</div>
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onclick="addEmbCatalogRow()">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg>
Novo Item
</button>
</div>
<div style="overflow-x:auto;padding:14px 16px;">
<div class="emb-cat-hdr">
<span></span><span>Nome</span><span>Tipo</span><span>Valor Compra (R$)</span><span>Qtd. / Metros</span><span>Frete (R$)</span><span>Custo Un. (auto)</span><span>Dim. C×L×A (cm)</span><span>Kit</span><span></span>
</div>
<div id="emb-cat-rows"></div>
<div id="emb-cat-empty" style="text-align:center;color:var(--t3);padding:20px;font-size:13px;">Nenhum item cadastrado ainda.</div>
</div>
</div>

function _hasRealData(d) {
return d && ((d.materiais||[]).length>0 || (d.impressoras||[]).length>0 || (d.catalog||[]).length>0 || (d.embalagens_catalog||[]).length>0);

function loadFromLocalStorage() {
try {
const s = localStorage.getItem(SK);
if (!s) return;
const lsData = JSON.parse(s);
if (_hasRealData(lsData)) D = { ...D, ...lsData };
else console.warn('localStorage parece vazio/corrompido, ignorando');
} catch(e) { console.warn('localStorage load failed:', e); }
D.embItems = [];
normalizeCatalog();
}
async function syncFromSupabase(rerender=false) {
try {
const timeout = new Promise((_,rej)=>setTimeout(()=>rej(new Error('timeout')),10000));
const query = sb.from('app_data').select('data').eq('id','main').maybeSingle();
const { data } = await Promise.race([query, timeout]);
if (!data || !data.data) return;
D = { ...D, ...data.data }; // Supabase é a fonte de verdade — sempre aplica
D.embItems = [];
normalizeCatalog();
try { localStorage.setItem(SK, JSON.stringify(D)); } catch(e) {}
if (rerender) renderAll();
} catch(e) { console.warn('Supabase sync failed/timeout:', e); }
}
function normalizeCatalog(){
(D.embalagens_catalog||[]).forEach(c=>{
if(!c.tipo) c.tipo='un';
if(!c.kit) c.kit=[];
if(c.comprimento_m===undefined) c.comprimento_m=0;
});
}
function save() {
D._savedAt = Date.now();
try {
createBackup();
localStorage.setItem(SK, JSON.stringify(D));
_setSaveStatus('saving');
} catch(e) {}
pushToSupabase();
}
function _setSaveStatus(state){
const el=document.getElementById('last-saved');
if(!el)return;
const hora=new Date().toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});
if(state==='saving') { el.textContent='Salvando...'; el.style.color=''; }
else if(state==='ok') { el.textContent='☁ Nuvem · '+hora; el.style.color='var(--green)'; }
else { el.textContent='⚠ Local · '+hora; el.style.color='var(--amber)'; }
}
async function pushToSupabase(attempt=1) {
try {
const { error } = await sb.from('app_data').upsert({
id: 'main',
data: D,
updated_by: SESSION_ID,
updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
});
if (error) {
if (attempt < 3) {
setTimeout(()=>pushToSupabase(attempt+1), 2000*attempt);
} else {
console.warn('Supabase save failed:', error);
_setSaveStatus('error');
}
} else {
_setSaveStatus('ok');
}
} catch(e) {
if (attempt < 3) {
setTimeout(()=>pushToSupabase(attempt+1), 2000*attempt);
} else {
console.warn('Supabase save failed:', e);
_setSaveStatus('error');
}
}
}
function toast(msg,bg='#1e293b'){
const el=document.getElementById('toast');
el.textContent=msg;el.style.background=bg;el.classList.add('show');
setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('show'),2200);
}
